meta.name: email-marketing
meta.description: 产品发布邮件, 含 masthead、hero、CTA、规格表, table-fallback

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成产品发布邮件，包含头部、主图、行动号召和规格表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为新产品发布制作专业营销邮件
copy.tagline_en: Generate product launch emails with masthead, hero, CTA, and spec table
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create professional marketing emails for a new product launch

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会生成一封纯 HTML 格式的产品发布邮件，包含品牌标志、图片占位、标题、正文、行动按钮、产品规格表格和页脚。邮件宽度 600 像素，使用表格布局兼容各类邮件客户端。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 写一封产品发布邮件或营销邮件时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一封新产品发布的营销邮件。
say.note: Claude 会生成完整邮件 HTML。

say.text: 生成一封包含产品规格表的发布邮件。
say.note: 邮件会包含 3 列规格网格。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates a pure HTML product launch email with brand logo, hero image placeholder, headline, body copy, primary CTA button, product specifications grid, and footer. The email is 600px wide and uses table-based layout for email client compatibility.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to write a product launch email or marketing email.

say_en.text: Write a marketing email for a new product launch.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the full email HTML.

say_en.text: Generate a launch email with a product specs table.
say_en.note: The email will include a 3-column specs grid.
